basis: FEED-009 P3: for the explicit base-2 prime exponent multiplier, the Legendre projection is preserved at every position after the first square-residue exception.
H008 already tested full-symbol equality lags, literal-hyphen association and four-rune collisions; this is a new lossy three-valued representation and a separate registered statistic family.
H010 was a complete negative for its full multiplicative decode/score branches, so this round tests the lower-cost projection consequence without adding an unregistered key search.
hypothesis: If the unsolved rune pages use a fixed base-2 prime-exponent multiplicative layer, an order-sensitive Legendre projection of the ciphertext may retain language-structured lag correlations even when full rune equality does not.
mechanistic_basis: chi(0)=0 and chi(x)=x^14 in F29 for nonzero x. For a_t=2^(p_t-1), chi(a_t)=1 for every t>=1; only the first exponent is a registered exception. The projection is a diagnostic consequence, not a decryption rule.
falsifiable_predictions: All 55 rune-bearing LP2 pages are tested at lags 1..28 within the original hard prose groups, yielding 1540 fixed page/lag cells; LP2/50 remains explicitly inapplicable.

The absolute mean product chi(C_i)*chi(C_(i+lag)) for at least one cell exceeds the family-wide maximum from 999 independent within-page rune permutations at adjusted p<=0.01 if a projected structural lead exists.
A complete scan with no adjusted lead is negative only for this projection, lag window, boundaries and permutation null; it does not reject the multiplicative family or the LP cipher.
The independent synthetic sensitivity check must reproduce the projection exactly for a base-2 prime-exponent encryption with the first plaintext rune fixed to F; failure is error, not negative.
applicable_objects: All 55 LP2 pages containing registered rune tokens; hard groups come from lossless token/layout parsing and no pair crosses a hard break.

excluded_objects.reason: No registered rune tokens; literal alphanumeric grid is outside this rune-projection experiment and is retained as unexecuted, not negative.

representation: chi(0)=0; chi(x)=+1 when pow(x,14,29)=1 and -1 otherwise for x=1..28. Original rune index and zero mask remain available; no Latin or GP conversion.
algorithm_version: H011-v1 / legendre-lag-v1: for each page and lag 1..28, compute abs(mean of chi products over pairs whose endpoints share a hard prose group).
parameter_derivation_policy: Lag window, group boundaries, absolute two-sided statistic, first-position handling, permutation seed, maxT correction and sensitivity control are fixed before the unknown-page statistics are inspected.
page_and_section_continuity_hypothesis: This statistic is position-local and does not assume a clock reset; numeric page boundaries and hard token groups are respected. The first-position exception is retained in the sequence, not silently edited.

scorer_and_acceptance_version.score: No language model and no candidate plaintext; absolute order-sensitive Legendre autocorrelation only.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.controls: 999 independent Python MT19937 within-page permutations preserving every page's full rune multiset, with fixed groups and lag cells.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.multiple_testing: Standardize each of 1540 cells using observed plus all controls; compare each observed z with the maximum z over all cells in every control replicate. Adjusted p=(1+exceedances)/1000.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.lead: A complete-control p<=0.01 cell is an exploratory projection lead and remains inconclusive until a new independent mechanism/key prediction is registered.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.decipherment: No page is accepted as decrypted from a projection lead, a high score, or a readable-looking mapping.

frozen_before_candidates: The runner stores all hashes, page/group layout, statistic definition, control seed and code snapshot before calculating unknown-page observed statistics or generating permutations.

total_budget.origin: Bounded local full-corpus projection diagnostic for auto-cycle R003; no side-chat budget inherited.

controls: 999 page-wise permutations preserve full rune counts and hard group masks.
Synthetic sensitivity: fixed heldout slice, first plaintext rune F, base-2 prime-exponent encryption, and exact chi preservation for all later positions.
Independent pure-Python chi/manual replay against the vectorized measurement; raw control matrix retained in NPZ.

randomness.role: Permutation controls only; never a key or plaintext seed.

discovery_path: Only lossless public rune indices and group masks are used. No reference plaintext, answer, dictionary, candidate key or external feed is read by the statistic.
independent_validation_path: Pure-Python product accumulation recomputes every observed page/lag statistic; an independent synthetic formula check verifies the stated Legendre multiplier property.
correlated_transform_deduplication: Only one projection family is tested. Absolute positive/negative correlations are combined in one two-sided statistic; no alternate roots, log28 views or mod4/mod7 projections are added.
uncovered_parameters: H010 full multiplicative decode already tested
other multiplicative bases/exponents and affine/composite layers
higher-order projection ngrams, lags >28 and alternative segmentation
LP2 grid/image geometry, transposition, page order and key recovery
next_step: If a projection lead appears, freeze a separate source-directed drilldown; otherwise count this as the third no-candidate round and force a method-family switch in R004.
note: This experiment tests a necessary consequence only under a restricted multiplier model. It cannot independently establish that LP uses that model.
